clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan's lower passages, Viscous Fallout drifts through the toxic runoff.

Radiation flooded Gnomeregan on Mekgineer Thermaplugg's treacherous advice, meant to wipe out the invading troggs. The fallout filled the city's lower levels with toxic slime and contamination. Viscous Fallout is a water elemental of those poisoned depths, its substance thick with the city's toxic waste. Its origins before the fall are unknown.

Viscous Fallout drifts through the irradiated lower passages as a living pool of toxic sludge. It spews volleys of toxin and lashes out at anything in its path. Those who enter Gnomeregan to cleanse its tainted depths must destroy the creature.
